definitions.full: H2908. tevath טְוָת adverb fastingly, hungrily (Syriac id. ; PS 1465 ; on etymology compare Schulth Hom. Wurz. 32 f. ; on adverb force of f. term. תָ֯ , see Nö § 155 A, M 201 W CG 135 ; and compare רַבַּת Psa 124:3 ); — Dan 6:18 .
